Attention, si vous renommez la commande,: Please note: If you rename the command, you must keep the last 10 characters that are also in the command; otherwise, the command will not work. (Depends on the version)
Avant de passer au plugin sous jeedom, i: Before switching to the Jeedom plugin, you need to unlock the gateway in the app. I actually had a pretty hard time figuring this out—I couldn’t get the plugin to learn the RF commands… In the app, select your gateway, then tap “…” in the top-right corner, and uncheck “Lock Device.” You’ll then be able to use the app and the plugin at the same time.

Sur l’onglet Commandes d’un équipement v: On the "Commands" tab for a device, you'll find the "Synchronize" button. If you have multiple Broadlink devices, you can transfer the learned commands from one Broadlink to another.
Sélectionnez un de vos équipements. Si c: Select one of your devices. If the devices are of the infrared type, a “Learn Command” button will appear at the top. Simply click it, and you’ll have 5 seconds to teach your Broadlink an infrared or 433 MHz command. After that, the plugin will confirm that the operation was successful and create the corresponding command, which you can then name.
Une nouvelle commande est normalement ap: A new command should now appear in Jeedom (it might not work right away, but be sure to follow these steps in order without rushing).

Vous pouvez choisir les commandes à tran: You can choose which commands to transfer and the Broadlink devices to which you want to transfer them. (The command name will, of course, be preserved—e.g., "TV ON," "fan off," etc.)
